findings.message: No scenes are enabled in the build settings
findings.remedy: A build would launch into nothing. Add at least the entry scene.
This ends up in the save path, the registry keys and the executable metadata.

findings.message: Application identifier is still a default ('com.DefaultCompany.testproject')
findings.remedy: Stores reject duplicates, and changing it later orphans existing saves.

findings.message: The project renders in gamma colour space
findings.remedy: Linear is correct for anything with real lighting. Switching late changes how every asset looks.
